title: Emotional Reflection Pool Laboratory
description: Students explore the science of emotions and mirror neurons in a virtual lab. A 3D face hovers above a reflective pool, and learners must assign emotional expressions to the face while the pool's water reacts with color-coded ripples representing neurotransmitter levels. The goal is to balance a set of six neurotransmitter concentrations by sequencing exactly the right emotions, respecting a conservation law where total neurotransmitter energy remains constant.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load facecap.glb and position it floating above and slightly forward of pool.glb, which sits at ground level as a reflective basin. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0,3,6) looking at origin. Add ambient light (0.4), a directional light from upper-right, and a subtle point light under the face that changes color with the current emotion. Implement these interactions: (1) A UI panel on the left lists 6 emotions: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, Surprise, Calm. Clicking one applies a morph target blend on the facecap model to animate the expression. (2) Each emotion maps to 6 neurotransmitter sliders (Serotonin, Dopamine, Cortisol, Adrenaline, Oxytocin, GABA) shown on the right panel. Applying an emotion shifts these values but the TOTAL across all 6 must always equal 100 (conservation law). (3) The pool water surface uses a custom ShaderMaterial with animated sine-wave displacement; its color blends RGB channels proportional to the top 3 neurotransmitter values. (4) A target neurotransmitter profile is displayed as a bar chart overlay. The student must reach the target by applying a sequence of emotions. (5) Each emotion application is one step; the task requires 10-14 steps to solve. (6) Implement full Undo and Redo buttons that revert both the face morph and neurotransmitter state. (7) A multi-input coupling slider lets the user adjust Expression Intensity (0-100%) which scales how strongly each emotion shifts neurotransmitters, requiring strategic planning. (8) Show a score percentage comparing current vs target profile. When score reaches 95%+, trigger a celebration: the pool emits particle sparkles and the face smiles. (9) Add a Reset button to restart. Use dat.gui or simple HTML overlays for UI. Ensure OrbitControls allow camera rotation around the scene.
